items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Ike Robinson; the interviewer mentions him. The interviewee's response ('You knew Jolly Roll, didn't you?') addresses the interviewer's acquaintance with Jolly Roll, not Ike Robinson.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jimmy Payne. Then I worked for him 17 years. Yes, I knew you'd been there. And then I worked for another woman, a white woman who had a studio down there at Jackson Boulevard, 22, East Jackson. Oh, yes. And then I got sick. I was in the hospital for four or five months, and I came out. My sister just died in November, in April. She'd been there almost two years now. Well, she had been there two years. Yes, you think this is that you have. So I haven't been doing anything since my sister died. I just stayed…
I went to see Ike Robinson who had played with Jolly Roll for a while, the banjo player. And his wife was having trouble with her teeth. But I had a nice interview. That was two days ago.
You knew Jolly Roll, didn't you?
